descriptionHtml:
Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S12 0 / 1 boundary: the empty state appears only when the list is really empty (Nursing Home Today 1 → 0 → 1, Hospital with one patient)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Empty patient list: a clear empty state with a way to add patients (scan or "+"). (UAT EFS state 1; TFA-94745 state 1)
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content. (UAT EFS intro; UAT 3.4; TFA-94745 AC 2)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Standard fixture: one Hospital patient, one resident on Today's Visits

When Look at the Hospital list; in Nursing Home turn the resident's In Today off, look at Today's Visits and All Residents; turn In Today back on and look at Today's Visits

Then With one patient no empty message shows; with 0 on Today the Today view shows its empty state with a way to add while All Residents still lists the resident; back to 1, the empty message is gone without a reload

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U1: cp1 mustContain {hospitalPatient}, mustNotContain 'no patients'; cp2 mustContain 'no residents' and 'scan', mustNotContain {snfResident}; cp3 mustContain {snfResident}, mustNotContain 'no residents'; cp4 mustContain {snfResident}, mustNotContain 'no residents'

Where it ran: dev unit U22; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: EFS Empty & Failure States · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: EFS/S12

0 / 1 boundary: the empty state appears only when the list is really empty (Nursing Home Today 1 → 0 → 1, Hospital with one patient)

Tickets: TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U22.verdict.json), unit U22 split by its parts' checkpoints. Agent: 81 turns, 275 s, $0.62.

Plan: unit U22 (#22, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Lists and cards, both contexts. Same legacy seed, same list screens. All four only look, open a chart, or flip In Today and flip it back. S13 (nothing entered is invented) runs first, before anything is opened. EFS S12 runs second: it turns In Today off and on and its checkpoint 4 checks the restore, so the parts after it start from a checked state. TC-01 S02 runs last, because its final tap ('tap it once more so it is back as it was') has no checkpoint after it. Runs together with TC-01/S13, TC-01/S01, TC-01/S02.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #22, U22; checked: yes): Fail (S02 only, product) — S02: NH card shows the diagnosis on Today's Visits and All Residents — same root cause as U01 (cluster C1: NH card diagnosis, TFA-92581 AC 3 / UAT TC-03 + TC-01). S13, EFS S12 (empty Today's Visits message + how to add), S01 pass
